_note: Starter knowledge base for the hackathon demo. Doses are common extension-style guidance; ALWAYS follow the product label and confirm with the local KVK / agriculture officer before spraying. Expand and cite sources (ICAR / TNAU / state agri university) before any real deployment.

early_blight.name: Early blight (Alternaria solani)
early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown concentric-ring spots ('target board') on older leaves, yellowing around spots.
organic: Remove and destroy affected lower leaves
Spray Trichoderma viride 5 g/L or neem oil 3 ml/L + sticky spreader
Copper oxychloride 3 g/L (also accepted in organic-leaning plans)
cultural: Rotate away from solanaceous crops next season

late_blight.name: Late blight (Phytophthora infestans)
late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked greasy patches turning brown-black, white fuzzy growth underneath in humid weather; fast spreading.
organic: Remove infected plants/leaves immediately and bury away from field
Preventive copper oxychloride 3 g/L on healthy plants
cultural: Do not move tools/labour from infected to healthy plots

leaf_curl_virus.name: Tomato leaf curl virus (whitefly-transmitted)
leaf_curl_virus.symptoms: Upward curling and crinkling of leaves, yellowing, stunted plants; whiteflies under leaves.
organic: Yellow sticky traps (about 10 per 1000 sq m)
Neem oil 3-5 ml/L or neem seed kernel extract 5% against whitefly
Uproot and destroy severely infected plants

chemical.active: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL (vector control only; virus itself cannot be cured)

cultural: Border crop of maize/sorghum as barrier

bacterial_spot.name: Bacterial spot (Xanthomonas)
bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small dark water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit, often with yellow halo; worse after rain.

purple_blotch.name: Purple blotch (Alternaria porri)
purple_blotch.symptoms: Small white sunken lesions that enlarge into purple-brown blotches with yellow edges on leaves and flower stalks.
organic: Neem oil 3 ml/L with sticky spreader

downy_mildew.name: Downy mildew (Peronospora destructor)
downy_mildew.symptoms: Pale elongated patches on leaves with greyish-violet fuzz in cool humid weather; leaves collapse.
